question: Klarna IPO in 2025?
description:
This market will resolve to "Yes" if Klarna completes an Initial Public Offering (IPO) by December 31, 2025, 11:59 PM ET, as confirmed by official company announcements and credible news sources. Otherwise, this market will resolve to "No".

If Klarna is acquired by another company that is already public, this market will immediately resolve to "No."

The resolution source for this market is a consensus of credible reporting.
